title: vaultEgressRules
responsibility: Renders the in-container network allowlist for a Credential Vault browser recipe.

inputs.name: vaultEgressRules.input
inputs.description: Recipe origins and redirects, the distinct nonroot proxy and browser user IDs, the loopback proxy port and the IPv4 resolver.

outputs.name: vaultEgressRules
outputs.description: An nftables ruleset for the container network namespace, dropping output by default, and the sorted hostnames the proxy may CONNECT to.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the users, port, resolver or origins are invalid.
